_comment: Every tool that declares reach anyone, with the reason it is safe: the in-code guard it relies on (callers list, presence proof, own-scope check, held at the Gate), or read-only. A tool with a mutating verb in its name needs a reason that names a guard; read-only does not count. PENDING reasons are tracked and shrink. test/reach-anyone.test.js fails on an anyone with no entry.

team.ask.reason: project check in code: only the person or a session in that project may ask; the request carries its asker and queues serially; a teammate's outward act still holds at the Gate

team.cancel.reason: owner check in code: only the requester or the person, and only a queued request; stopping a running one is the person's

team.charter.diff.reason: read-only; scope check in code: the person, the assistant, a session in the teammate's project, or the teammate itself

team.charter.draft.reason: project check in code (person, assistant or a session in the project, never a teammate); saved as a new version the person can read and revert

team.charter.get.reason: read-only; scope check in code: the person, the assistant, a session in the teammate's project, or the teammate itself

team.charter.history.reason: read-only; scope check in code: the person, the assistant, a session in the teammate's project, or the teammate itself

team.default.get.reason: read-only; callers limited in code to the person's surfaces and modules, never mcp

team.done.reason: owner check in code: only the teammate whose request it is, and only while it is running

team.duties.create.reason: scope check in code; a model's duty is only a proposal (off, no watcher) until the person turns it on, and a teammate may only propose for itself

team.duties.list.reason: read-only; scope check in code: the person, the assistant, a session in the project, or the teammate itself

team.duties.update.reason: owner check in code: a model may only pause or edit a proposal; turning one on or editing a running duty is refused, that is the person's tap

team.fail.reason: owner check in code: only the teammate whose request it is, and only while it is running

team.list.reason: read-only; scope check in code: the caller's own project, and every project only for the person or the assistant

team.merge.reason: owner check in code: only the project's integrator, and only with an attested passing exit code; main moves by compare-and-swap and the result says an agent vouched for it

team.notes.reason: owner check in code: the teammate itself or the person writes its notes; a session in the project reads them

team.project-append.reason: read-only; callers limited in code to the person's surfaces and modules, never mcp

team.project-has-any.reason: read-only; callers limited in code to the person's surfaces and modules, never mcp

team.status.reason: read-only; owner check in code: the requester, the teammate or the person

undo.list.reason: read-only, scoped by the module itself

undo.run.reason: PENDING: mutating, no mechanical guard: the owner names the guard it relies on
